messages:
sam: Heads-up — embeddings-serve in eu-west1 is seeing a small but persistent 5xx tail after the config change. I built a hotfix image (gcr.io/redwood/serve:hotfix-891) that reverts the new pooling path. Requesting expedited approvals to push a midnight patch and run a 5% canary -> 30% ramp.
deploy-bot: @sam created rollout r-2024-891. Canary target: embeddings-serve.eu-west1. Step 1: 5% (00:05), step 2: 30% (00:15). CI checks passing. Approval required: 2 approvers (eng + s-re).
elaine: +1 from product. This is user-visible latency spikes on multi-tenant flows, so agree with quick window. :thumbsup:
raj: oncall-sre here — can we define rollback criteria before starting? Propose: if p95 latency increases by >120ms OR error rate across canary >0.4% sustained for 5m OR tail 5xx spike > 0.3%. If any trigger, auto-pin traffic back to rev-890 and pause rollout.
mike: Agree with those metrics. Also ensure old image is kept in the pool and the rollout metadata includes the previous image tag so we can promote back quickly. I'll add the rollout label "hotfix-rollback-prep".
olivia: Quick release-note snippet added in the PR: "Temporary revert of pooling optimization to address intermittent 5xx errors on embeddings in EU. Will re-enable after deeper investigation." Linking PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4258
oncall-sre: +1 from SRE. Confirming metric alerts wired: canary-promote-alert and canary-roll-back playbook linked. I'll stay on watch.
sam: Great — two approvals. Starting canary now. Running the 5% step.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 in progress: 5% -> in-flight. Logs available at https://ops.redwood/rollouts/r-2024-891/logs
sam: Monitoring dashboard shows steady error rate dropping, latency within proposed thresholds. Proceeding to 30% in 10m. @raj keep an eye on p95 and error churn.
raj: Seen the dashboards. Small blip cleared, no sustained breach. :eyes:
mike: Going to tag the rollback command here for quick use if needed:

```bash
# rollback to previous stable image
deployctl promote --rollout r-2024-891 --to-image gcr.io/redwood/serve:rev-890 --force --reason "auto-rollback"
```

sam: If anything flares up during the 30% step, we'll execute the rollback command and notify infra and product. Otherwise we'll finish the ramp and publish the short release note. Thanks everyone for fast reviews. :lock:
